g.text: Black-box implementation unit (a class or cohesive cluster)
Assembly-scoped interface; cross-team consumers may NOT bind
Unity ACL — single class touching UnityEngine in its package
Cross-team boundary = the External package edge. Only public lollipops
cross it; «internal» interfaces stay inside their owning assembly per DD-5.
legacy class was decomposed across the Features package and not replaced.
